Actuals: 1. Revenue is in $ thousands; volumes and USDC balances are on Drivers.
3. Net revenue = transaction revenue + subscription and services (S&S).
4. Total revenue = net revenue + corporate interest and other income.
5. Q4 2025 detail = originally reported full year less Q1 through Q3.
6. 2025 figures retain the original presentation, including corporate USDC in stablecoin.
7. 2026 presents corporate USDC income in corporate interest and other income.
8. Stablecoin, S&S, net and corporate revenue are not fully comparable across that change.
9. The reclassification changes revenue categories, not total revenue.
Drivers: 1. Spot volume is in $ billions; total spot volume = consumer + institutional.
2. Source: Q2 2026 earnings deck, p.39 (spot volume) and pp.13/40 (USDC).
3. Source: Q1 2025 shareholder letter, May 8, 2025 (Q1 volume and $12.3B USDC).
4. Spot volume excludes derivatives and stablecoin trading volume.
5. Revenue rows link to Actuals; historical ratios calculate from those linked values.
6. Consumer effective take rate = consumer revenue / (consumer spot volume x 1,000,000).
7. Institutional effective take rate uses institutional revenue and institutional spot volume.
8. These are revenue-to-spot-volume ratios, not quoted trading fees.
9. Non-spot revenue and product mix can change either effective take rate.
10. Take-rate levels display as percentages; forecast changes are entered in basis points.
11. One basis point = 0.0001; add the change divided by 10,000 to the prior rate.
12. Average USDC in products: 12.3 / 14 / 15 / 18 / 19 / 20 ($B), Q1 2025 to Q2 2026.
13. Average total USDC market cap: 54 / 61 / 68 / 76 / 75 / 77 ($B), rounded.
14. Total market cap includes Coinbase and off-platform USDC balances.
15. Total USDC market cap is context only; it does not feed the simplified forecast.
16. Effective quarterly revenue rate = stablecoin revenue / (average Coinbase USDC x 1,000,000).
17. This effective ratio includes off-platform economics; it is not the reserve interest yield.
18. 2025 effective rates use as-reported revenue; see Actuals for the classification difference.
19. Forecast USDC balances and effective rates change using separate Inputs assumptions.
21. Institutional spot volume stays flat; institutional revenue uses its own growth input.
22. S&S excludes other transaction revenue; S&S mix = total S&S / net revenue.
23. Assumptions remain placeholders; the Q3 earn-out roll-off adjustment is still pending.
Blockchain rewards revenue grows by the selected scenario assumption, reflecting the combined effects of crypto prices, staking balances, network reward rates, and Coinbase’s retained share.
